full_judgment:
Mr. Mohammad Fazlul Karim, J: The plaintiff-petitioner seeks leave to appeal against the judgment and order dated 19.6.2004 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.5102 of 2003 making the rule absolute setting aside the judgment and decree dated 20.11.2003 of the Additional District Judge, First Court, Dhaka in Family Appeal No. 36 of 2003 reversing those dated 20.8.2003 of the Additional Assistant Judge, 3rd Court and Family Court, Dhaka in Family Suit No.235 of 2003. 

 4. Upon hearing the suit was decreed whereupon the defendant Nos.1 and 2 preferred an appeal which was allowed in modified form given custody of the minor daughter with the mother of Mushrat Jahan with certain direction as under: 

 As per modified decree the father of Mehtaj or Power of Attorney of father of Mehtaj will have every right to meet the infant Mehtaj on 1st and 15th day of every English month at place as desired by Mehtaj's father or his Power of attorney within Dhaka City. For said meeting purpose Mushrat Jahan or her power of attorney is directed to hand over the infant Mehtaj to Mehtaj's father or said father's power of attorney at place and at time mentioned above at best for 12 (twelve) hours on each date and after said meeting infant Mehtaj must be returned to her mother or power of attorney of her mother by father or power of attorney of Mehtaj's father in each time."
